t.en: Each time something is declared, the kernel makes its <wiki-ref to="elim-rule"></wiki-ref> from the ways in. This branch builds that part of the kernel by hand.

On this board the wires carry rules themselves. Two inputs: the declared sentence (its letters turned into ?A and ?B, since the rule made must hold for any sentences) and its <wiki-ref to="intro-rule"></wiki-ref>. The parts in the tray take rules apart and put them together. Each test is a declaration with one way in, and the elimination rule to make.

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that makes the elimination rule of a declaration with one introduction rule.

hint.en: Compare the way in with the elimination rule to make: which part carries over as it is, and which is replaced?
